payload.text: SAFETY — limit utilization is a total, fail-closed ratio (deliverable: limits-breach-detection). LimitSpec::utilization(exposure) is a pure deterministic function: it returns |exposure|/cap when cap > 0, f64::INFINITY when cap == 0 (or negative) and |exposure| > 0, and 0.0 only when both are zero. The zero-cap → INFINITY branch is the fail-closed safety property: a zero cap is treated as an instant breach, never as an unbounded/divide-by-zero allowance, so a misconfigured zero limit can never silently admit risk. It reads only &self and the f64 argument; no I/O, mutation, or allocation. Self-invalidates if the zero-cap branch stops returning INFINITY.
